title: Windwalker / Devastation / Mistweaver vs RMP
summary: Your Evoker holds three answers and no escape but Hover. Kill the Mage inside one window or you do not get another.

sections.title: One window, on the Mage
sections.body: Counts, theirs: Rogue 6, Priest 5, Mage 4. Yours: Mistweaver 5, Windwalker 4, Evoker 3. Your Evoker is the thinnest player in the game and a Sub Rogue is built to reach him. The Mage is their thinnest and two of his four only reset the go. This comp gets a very narrow damage window, so everything has to be in position before it opens.

sections.title: Before the go — the setup is the plan

steps.note: 30s. On the Priest, before any damage starts.
30s. Second category on the same target.
90s root on the Mage so he cannot walk the window off.

sections.title: The go — narrow, so open it already stacked

steps.note: 50s. The stun the whole window sits inside.
60s. Lands in the sweep, never before it.
70s. Your slowest term — the cadence is this, not Leg Sweep.
120s. It ends the window rather than shortening it.
120s. He resets and you have spent Zenith.
25s. It is the answer to your melee, not to damage.
30s. He is on the Evoker whenever he wants to be.
12s. Opens on your thinnest player for free.
No cooldown, and your Evoker has three answers total.
